term: a contingent member of the fixed joint condition
definition: Some f belongs to S and satisfies the existing Contingent A w f: it holds actually and fails at an accessible world. This does not say that every member is contingent or that f is individually sufficient or indispensable for an effect.
note: Owner-proposed simplification on 2026-10-31. Logical conjunction packaging, not a new causal substance or an attributed historical claim.
